rungs.new_knowledge: Waiting is a candidate decision linked to the actual crossing and oncoming traffic.
Three alternatives at each of three stages produce 27 sequences in this example.
A trajectory links dependent interactions to a goal rather than being an isolated line.
Changing relevance to a candidate interaction does not justify ignoring the road user.
Candidate evaluation can consider several behavior factors rather than an invented single score.
Threshold pruning stops developing a poor candidate and directs expansion toward promising nodes.
An application about planning does not establish deployment or feature parity for a specific hardware generation.
The viewer can distinguish pruning candidate decisions from losing representation of an agent.

scope: Structural/editorial planning validation; no measured audience retention or guarantee of engagement
